text:
Both summaries are under 120 words and get the core dates, figures and the next meeting right. Response A has one accuracy problem: it says the council "will install a speed counter" on Wattle Road, but the minutes say Councillor Tse would *ask* council traffic staff to install one and report back. That turns a request into a commitment. Response B states this correctly ("Tse will request a speed counter"). B also names who is responsible for the Clean Up Day and the carols sound system, which a manager would want to know. A omits those owners and the Facebook action item. A's inclusion of the school choir is a small plus, but it doesn't outweigh B's better accuracy and clearer ownership. B is slightly longer, but the extra words carry correct, useful detail.

Verdict: B
